The '''Protector 1''' was a [[battle armor]] used by many [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] and [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was produced by [[Tagge Company/Legends|Tagge Company]] and cost 5,500 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="DC" />
